NUH.name: Nuh
NUH.look: a tall, strong, kind old man with deep dark brown skin, a full white beard and short white hair, in a long simple indigo-blue robe over a cream tunic

SON.name: Nuh's son
SON.look: a proud young man of about twenty with deep dark brown skin, short black hair and a thin beard, in a long-sleeved rust-orange tunic that reaches below his knees, over loose brown trousers
